inventoryNote: Every FileAPI and xhr/formdata path and the requested url/urlencoded-parser fixture is selected, used as support, excluded with a reason or classified as metadata. Source files are unedited. Counts describe one ordinary-node host execution, not every WPT global variant. Two Document-dependent registrations are listed separately and never counted as executed or blocked.

nodeCompatibilityContext.note: FileAPI and url use exact versions.json directory commits. Node does not vendor xhr/formdata, which uses the recent revision reserved by Fetch A3. Every Node-vendored FileAPI and URL byte sequence was independently checked against upstream Git blobs; none differs. Node omits one FileAPI and three URL Python resources, which are inventoried from upstream. Node expected failures and platform-specific skips below are compatibility context only and do not skip package cases.
